title: NLP Privacy Risk Identification in Social Media (NLP-PRISM): A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review mapping bias across NLP tasks, combined with an empirical evaluation of privacy-utility trade-offs using Attribute Inference Attacks (AIA) via probing classifiers to predict gender from model representations.

Systematic literature review identifying disproportionate toxicity flagging and sociolect bias, and empirical evaluation using Attribute Inference Attacks (AIA) to predict dialect attributes from language model embeddings.
Systematic literature review assessing how sentiment, emotion, and offensive language models misinterpret cultural affect and penalize culturally marked expressions.
Systematic literature review analyzing monolingual bias, L1/L2 focus disparities, and code-switching penalties in code-mixed and native language identification NLP tasks.
